build_nav_to_obj_task: build a python module to create a DynNavRLEnv task that navigates an articulated agent to a random object
create_nav_to_info_dataclass: create a NavToInfo dataclass to store navigation goal position and agent start pose for a task
test_DynNavRLEnv_reset: test the DynNavRLEnv reset method to verify agent positioning and object grasping on episode reset
refactor_generate_nav_start_goal: refactor the _generate_nav_start_goal method to support custom distance filtering for agent start positions
review_set_args: review the DynNavRLEnv set_args method to force navigation to a specific object or receptacle marker
